name: Bulgarian Open 2018
information: First WCA competition in Bulgaria. Maximum 1 guest per competitor. Registration fee to be paid in the venue on the day of the competition. The address of the Technical university of Sofia is 8 Kliment Ohridski boulevard, but the entrance of the venue is on Rosario street. Първо състезание на WCA в България. Позволени са максимум 1 гост за състезател (лимит на стаята). Адресът на Технически университет - гр. София е бул. "Климент Охридски" 8, но входът към блок 3 е откъм ул. Росарио. Two weeks before the competition, registered competitors will be requested by email to confirm their participation. Registered competitors must reply at least three days before the competition, otherwise they may be removed from the competitor list.
